text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Socialist Union of People's Forces (USFP) says change is a political necessity.
- Morocco and France to start research programme to measure effect of pollution in Casablanca and its effect on health.
- Banque Marocaine du Commerce et de l'Industrie reinstates laid off employee following staff sit-in.
- Leader of Progress and Socialism Party (PPS) Ali Yata says voting for his party means streamlining spending and consolidating democracy.
- Fire in a Casablanca shack kills two.
- Top of a Fez mosque being built collapses, killing one and injuring three.
